title: KalmarCTF 2024
description:
Welcome to KalmarCTF 2024, brought to you by the Kalmarunionen

The competition will take place on Fri, 15 Mar. 2024, 17:00 UTC to Sun, 17 Mar. 2024, 17:00 UTC.

This year's competition will feature a variety of categories including pwn, crypto, web, rev, and of course miscgang will deliver.

More information coming soon!
prizes:
First place: 3 IDA PRO named licenses* with 2 decompilers
Second place: 2 IDA PRO licenses* with 2 decompilers
Third place: 1 IDA PRO license* with 2 decompilers

*All licenses are perpetual with one year of support and upgrades included.
